name: alehouse
title: Alehouse
description: A village-pub theme whose masthead is the pub fascia — the house name in fat gilt slab capitals with a hard red drop shade on a black board the full width of the page — over a whitewashed front with black-framed window panes for the hours and a red door for bookings, turning to polished mahogany and ivory after dark.

tokens.--font-slab: the lettering: the house name on the fascia, the menu's section names, and every small capital label — menu links, side headings, pane labels, prices, the booking button
tokens.--font-body: body text, page titles, dish names and descriptions — the transitional serif
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--text-fascia: size of the house name on the fascia, from the narrowest phone to a wide screen
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing in the small capital labels
tokens.--shade: how far the red drop shade falls below and to the right of each gilt letter
tokens.--color-bg: page background (mahogany, or the whitewashed wall in a light scheme)
tokens.--color-text: body text, page titles, dish names and prices, the heavy rules (above side headings, under table headings, beside quotations, over the post list), focus rings
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dish descriptions, pane labels, dates, quotations, page numbers
tokens.--color-panel: the panes of the hours window
tokens.--color-rule: thin dividing lines: between menu lines, between posts, in tables, above a post's tags
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code and code blocks
tokens.--color-door-ink: the words and the thin inner line on the booking button
tokens.--color-board: the black boards: the fascia and its brackets, the menu's section boards, the footer, the frame and glazing bars of the hours window, and the thin line cut between each gilt letter and its shade
tokens.--color-moulding: the lighter bands along the top and bottom of the fascia and the top of the footer
tokens.--color-lining: the cream line painted round each board and bracket, the plain lettering on the boards (menu links, footer text), and focus rings on the boards
tokens.--color-gilt: the gold leaf: the house name and the menu's section names, nothing else
tokens.--color-shade: the red drop shade behind the gilt letters
tokens.--page-width: maximum width of the page under the fascia
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of running text
tokens.--col-label: width of the left column that holds side headings and post dates on wide screens
tokens.--bar: weight of the woodwork: the window's glazing bars and frame, the heavy rules, focus rings
tokens.--radius: corner rounding on images and code
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: under a label, between a name and its description; the thin moulding under the fascia and over the footer
tokens.--space-2: small gap: inside labels and links, the moulding on top of the fascia
tokens.--space-3: gap between paragraphs, padding inside panes, the page gutter on phones
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections and columns, the page gutter on wide screens
